cards.text: The prophet Zechariah is still seeing visions, and an angel is still showing him around. This time the angel shows him Joshua the high priest, standing before the angel of the LORD. And standing at Joshua's right hand? Satan.

cards.question: Satan is standing at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to ___ him.
Then the LORD speaks, and He talks straight to Satan. What does He say?

answers.text: You may test him for a time

cards.text: Then the LORD asks about Joshua: "Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?" Snatched. Not strolled out. Not politely escorted. SNATCHED.
Now look at Joshua, standing there before the angel. Let's just say his clothes are not ready for company. Friend, I spent years under the dust in a junk drawer. I KNOW that look.

cards.question: What is Joshua the high priest dressed in as he stands before the angel?
So the angel gives an order to those standing before him about Joshua. What is it?

answers.text: Send him out of the camp
Let him wash in the river

cards.question: Then the angel tells Joshua what taking off those clothes means: his ___ has been removed.
The angel also promises Joshua something new to wear: splendid robes.

cards.text: Then Zechariah himself speaks up. The man is just watching a vision, and he jumps in with WARDROBE notes. I love it. That's me every time somebody stamps a cookie crooked.

cards.question: What does Zechariah ask them to put on Joshua?

answers.text: A clean turban on his head
A signet ring on his hand

cards.text: So a clean turban goes on Joshua's head, and they clothe him, while the angel of the LORD stands by. Then the angel of the LORD gives Joshua a charge, straight from the LORD of Hosts.

cards.question: The LORD's promise to Joshua starts with an "if." What does Joshua have to do?

answers.text: Walk in My ways and keep My instructions
Rebuild the wall around all of Jerusalem
Offer a lamb on the altar every morning

cards.question: If Joshua does, he'll govern the LORD's house and have charge of His courts. The LORD will also give him a place among whom?

answers.text: The ones standing there in the vision
The kings who ruled over Judah
The elders who sat at the gate

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Joshua and his companions seated before him, and He says they are indeed a sign. Then He announces He's about to bring someone.

cards.question: Who does the LORD say He is going to bring?

cards.text: Next the LORD points to a stone He has set before Joshua. On that one stone are seven eyes, and He says He will engrave an inscription on it. Friend, I stamp cookies for a living, and I have NEVER stamped anything like that.

cards.question: Joshua's iniquity was removed. Now the LORD says He'll remove the iniquity of the whole land. How long will it take?
On that day, the LORD of Hosts says, each of them will invite a neighbor to do what?

answers.text: Sit with them under their vine and fig tree
Stand with them on guard at the city wall
Help them rebuild the house of the LORD

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave Zechariah for now. Keep your apron on, friend. This prophet is not done seeing things yet.
